_readme: Fruit worth naming in a post, by the months it is actually in the market in
Andhra Pradesh and Telangana — not when a supermarket can fly it in.
`months` are inclusive and wrap around the year end (11-2 means November to
February). `note` is one line on what it is good for, in the channel's own
register: no health claims, nothing a doctor would have to correct.
Seasons shift a few weeks either way with the year, so treat a month at the
edge of a range as 'probably around'. Edit freely — this is local knowledge
and whoever runs the shop knows it better than this file does.

fruits.name: Mango
fruits.note: Banganapalli, Suvarnarekha, Rasalu. The whole summer is built around it.

fruits.name: Watermelon
fruits.note: Mostly water, which is the point in April. Cheap and everywhere.

fruits.name: Muskmelon
fruits.note: Cooling and soft. Good for elders and small children.

fruits.name: Jamun
fruits.note: Short season, sold by the roadside in cones with salt.

fruits.name: Guava
fruits.note: Cheap for months, high in fibre, and eaten with chilli and salt.

fruits.name: Custard apple (sitaphal)
fruits.note: Short season, very sweet, soft enough for anyone to eat.

fruits.name: Pomegranate
fruits.note: Keeps well and travels well. Good in a lunchbox.

fruits.name: Sweet lime (mosambi)
fruits.note: Juiced everywhere in winter. Better eaten than juiced — the fibre stays.

fruits.name: Orange
fruits.note: Nagpur oranges arrive in winter and are cheapest then.

fruits.name: Sapota (chikoo)
fruits.note: Very sweet and soft. Small portions suit anyone watching sugar.

fruits.name: Papaya
fruits.note: All year, ripens on the counter, and easy on the stomach.

fruits.name: Banana
fruits.note: All year, needs no cutting, no plate and no cooking.

fruits.name: Ber (regi pandu)
fruits.note: Winter roadside fruit, sold by the cup with salt and chilli.

fruits.name: Wood apple (velaga pandu)
fruits.note: Local, seasonal, and mostly made into a chutney or a sherbet.

fruits.name: Tender coconut
fruits.note: All year and best in the heat. Cheaper than any bottled drink.

fruits.name: Pineapple
fruits.note: Sold cut, with salt and chilli, through the monsoon.

fruits.name: Sugarcane
fruits.note: Juiced at the roadside through the cool months.
